description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/lax_friedrichs_D_periodic driven by problems/advection_1d_periodic_lax_friedrichs.esm (model AdvectionLaxFriedrichs), loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4). Exact solution sin(2 pi (x - c t)). First-order upwind damping, O(dx) (the Rusanov flux reduces to upwind for linear advection, so these errors match problems/advection_1d_periodic to the bit).
